assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries registered by the repository.
assumptions.impact: All area, length, overlap and location-sensitive findings must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines and building control lines are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No proposed footprint, massing or land-use share is a statutory control conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, structural condition, utilities, fire access and heritage inventories are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Retain, adapt and new-build labels are method priorities, not demolition approvals.

assumptions.statement: Food safety, cold-chain, kitchen exhaust, grease, wastewater, waste and soil conditions require specialist review.
assumptions.impact: Edible landscapes and test kitchens cannot open until health, environment, fire and accessibility checks pass.

assumptions.statement: Repository issue #846 reports a mismatch between available mapped heritage and provisional key-area geometries.
assumptions.impact: The proposal treats heritage interfaces as sensitive and avoids claiming exact overlap or conservation boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service retains a staffed, non-digital fallback and a documented shutdown path.
assumptions.impact: Operating budgets and responsible entities must be confirmed before deployment.
